title: My family
summary: Say whose something is with the possessive suffixes, say what you have with *var* and *yok*, and handle the words that lose a vowel or soften a consonant before them.
canDo: Talk about your family and say who is who
Say what you have and what you don't have
Name aunts, uncles and grandparents on each side of the family
Say that your head, eye or foot hurts
